faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IGNTU Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IGNTU Project Assistant position is 07-09-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. in Geology or Applied Geology with a minimum of 55% marks to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Assistant position at Indira Gandhi National Tribal University (IGNTU).

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 20,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the IGNTU Project Assistant recruitment must be submitted via email.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Assistant post will involve an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is Indira Gandhi National Tribal University located?
faq.answer: Indira Gandhi National Tribal University (IGNTU) is located in Amarkantak, Madhya Pradesh.

faq.question: Q9. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job opportunity for the Project Assistant position.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is provided in the "Important Links" section of this article for your convenience.
